belief_limitation_note: Config n8-s16-b4-d8: eight particles, sixteen target simulations, leaf batch four, search depth eight. Shipped deliberately, and it is not a configuration anyone has measured. M7 latency-qualified n8-s32-b4-d8 on one x86 core (p99.9 140 ms, max 141, zero moves over 150, twenty simulations) and left its strength unproven at +18.15 +/- 23.42; the parity config M6 rated and the parity harness ran against is s16-d2. This is neither. M7's cost model says a simulation's cost is its leaf forward rather than its tree walk, so depth 2 -> 8 is expected to be nearly free, but that is an inference from other points of the grid and not a measurement of this one. The offline_p99_ms values below are still the PYTHON's measured costs, wrong for this binary by roughly the ratios in docs/research/measurements/morpheus-rs-belief-bench.md; they are here to make admission behave predictably, not because they describe this bot. Qualification verdict: no on any host.
